subject: Committee resolution: band review and outcome for SR Infra SRE candidate
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 17:08:00 -0800
Subject: SR Infra SRE candidate debrief + band recommendation (Alexei Romanov)

Team —

Thanks for joining the debrief this afternoon. Attached are the consolidated panel notes and Alexei's resume for reference. Quick TL;DR from the interviews and calibration:

- Strengths: deep systems troubleshooting, distributed storage debugging, very strong postmortem instincts.
- Gaps: limited production scale experience on our tech stack (Kubernetes multi-cluster autoscale patterns), unclear leadership in cross-team projects.
- Interview feedback split 2/3 recommend proceed to offer talk if we widen the band; 1/3 recommend no hire based on lack of product-scale ownership experience.

Comp band context: Alexei asked for mid-to-high band for SR Infra SRE (band 5). Our compensation band reference (attached) shows market midpoint closer to band 4 for this profile in Q1/Q2 hiring plan. If we want to meet expectations we'd need to approve an uplift to band 5 for this hire or a targeted sign-on.

Recommendation (draft): No hire at current band. Two options: 1) Approve a one-off band uplift to band 5 and proceed to offer with a targeted sign-on, or 2) Close out candidate (no offer) and reallocate headcount to Platform Reliability where we have stronger immediate needs and a better match to the skills demonstrated.

Please reply with your position + rationale. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll make a final call and loop recruiting/HR.

Attachments: Alexei_Romanov_Resume.pdf; panel_notes_alexei_20260226.docx; salary_band_reference_Q2_2026.pdf

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 19:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SR Infra SRE candidate debrief + band recommendation (Alexei Romanov)

Michael —

Thanks for the thorough write-up and for consolidating notes. I agree with the behavioral and technical assessment: strong fundamentals but a gap on platform-scale ownership. Band uplift feels high risk for a candidate who hasn't demonstrated product-scale project leadership.

My vote: No hire at band 5. If recruiting can offer band 4 + smaller sign-on, I'm open to proceeding only if Alexei accepts a strong growth plan and we put a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to ownership milestones. Otherwise, close out and move the headcount.

Two operational questions:
- If we close this, can we move the headcount immediately to Platform Reliability (requested in last-week backlog)?
- If we approve uplift, what is the precedent and budget owner for the delta? (need HR/finance sign-off)

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SR Infra SRE candidate debrief + band recommendation (Alexei Romanov)

Following up — I concur with Laura. Given Q2 budget tightening and product priorities, I do not support a band uplift for this role. We have to be disciplined on precedent setting.

Proposal: Close the candidate with thoughtful feedback (I'll draft language for recruiting) and reassign the headcount to 'Platform Reliability (IC hire)' to accelerate a backlog of platform toil elimination. We should allow recruiting to keep the profile open but change the req to prioritize production-scale ownership experience.

Priya — please confirm whether HR can process the headcount reallocation this sprint and flag any payroll/banding implications. If HR needs formal sign-off I'm happy to approve.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Engineering Operations

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Katherine Lin <kate@greentechtalent.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final: no-offer decision and headcount reallocation (Alexei Romanov)

Thanks all — consensus captured: NO OFFER for Alexei at this time.

Action items (assignments):
- Recruiting (cc'd Kate): Close out candidate today and send constructive feedback per Evelyn's draft. Request candidate remains in feeder pool for senior platform roles.
- Priya/HR: Please reallocate the approved headcount from INFRA-SRE-0123 to the new req 'Platform Reliability - IC' and confirm any band implications; Evelyn has pre-approved the reallocation pending your check on payroll/band admin.
- Aditya/Michael: We'll update the hiring tracker (link below) and reprioritize the backlog for the Platform Reliability req.

Rationale (for records): Candidate demonstrated solid systems skills but not the proven product-scale ownership we're prioritizing for SR Infra SRE. Given budget posture and precedent concerns, uplift is not justified. Reallocating headcount gets us closer to immediate impact.
